title: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Registration of Audit Committees)
① Any person who wishes to become an audit committee as defined in Article 2, paragraph 7, subparagraph (na) of the "Act on External Auditing of Corporations, etc." (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") (hereinafter referred to as the "Audit Committee") must meet all of the following requirements and register with the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants (hereinafter referred to as the "KICPA"), which was established in accordance with Article 41 of the "Act on Certified Public Accountants,"
1. The members must be certified public accountants registered in accordance with Article 7 of the "Act on Certified Public Accountants" and have completed practical training as specified in Article 10 of the "Act on External Auditing of Corporations, etc." (hereinafter referred to as the "Regulations")
2. The members must be at least 3 in number
3. The members must not fall under Article 26, paragraph 1, subparagraph 2 or 3 of the "Act on Certified Public Accountants"
4. The members must not be members of an accounting firm (hereinafter referred to as the "Accounting Firm") or another audit committee as defined in Article 23 of the "Act on Certified Public Accountants"
② The applicant must submit the following documents to the KICPA:
1. Registration application
2. Audit committee

Agreements reached among members regarding operations, etc.
3. Documents that can prove that all members have agreed to the agreement specified in item 2.
4. Other documents as specified by the Korean Public Accountants Association.
③ Upon receiving the documents specified in item 2, the Korean Public Accountants Association shall issue a registration certificate to the applicant.
④ After issuing a registration certificate to the applicant, the Korean Public Accountants Association shall document and manage the following items:
1. Registration number of the audit committee
2. Name and address of the member
3. Location of the member's office
4. Principal office of the audit committee
5. Other items as specified by the Korean Public Accountants Association.
④ The Korean Public Accountants Association may cancel the registration if the audit committee fails to meet any of the following conditions. However, if any of items 1 to 3 fail to meet the requirements, the registration shall be cancelled.
1. Failure to meet the requirements of item 1 within 3 months from the date of failure.
2. Any fraudulent act, such as falsifying documents specified in items 2.

If registered as a committee:

3. If the committee has resolved to dissolve;
4. If the committee is conducting an audit of a company as required by Article 4 of the Act, and fails to comply with the following:
    a. At least three members must participate;
    b. All members participating in the audit must sign or initial the audit report as required by Article 18(1) of the Act;
    c. A report detailing the company's operating results for the previous fiscal year must be submitted to the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants by June 30 each year.

⑤ If the committee has any changes to the requirements in each item of Article 1, or has resolved to dissolve, it must immediately notify the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants.
